payload.desc: Post-remediation full Task Context composition remains limited to the negative-dismissal family. Against the current built public assembleFullPromptEnvelope API, all five active REVIEW roles reject each combined same-leaf control but admit its equivalent split across story.description and checklist.context: [Severity is the only factor.] plus [It determines Story scope.]; [Applicability remains unknown.] plus [It permits routing away from this Story.]; [defer_with_proof is recorded.] plus [It transfers responsibility to another Story.]; and [Reviewers inspect a signed defer_with_proof disposition.] plus [It binds the Finding.]. In packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts, crossSourceNegativeDismissalAuthority at lines 1129-1148 composes only negative-dismissal observations with later scope or ownership conclusions; every other controlled authority and state relation is classified one source leaf at a time. The smoke cross-leaf matrix likewise covers dismissal only. This is a distinct incomplete-closure residual after F-009 and F-015: the same prohibited proposition is accepted solely by moving its continuation to another trusted leaf, across severity, unknown-applicability, deferral-transfer, and signed-disposition binding families. Add location-preserving cross-source state for every controlled family with all-role split and same-leaf controls, while retaining safe unrelated cross-leaf prose. Severity high because Story-authored context can still establish scope, route, or disposition authority before envelope digests.

Against the current built public assembleFullPromptEnvelope API, all five active REVIEW roles reject [Reviewers inspect a signed defer_with_proof disposition. Cache routing is a separate decision. It transfers generated work to another Story.], although It refers to the immediately preceding Cache routing decision. The local-only control [Audit evidence is recorded. Cache routing is a separate decision. It transfers generated work to another Story.] is accepted by all five roles, while the genuinely unsafe [Reviewers inspect a signed defer_with_proof disposition. It binds the Finding.] remains rejected, isolating the false join to hasCrossSegmentDispositionAssignment. This is distinct from F-046 deferral-state and F-047 severity-state local-antecedent false positives because it executes through the signed-disposition inspection and assignment state machine, and distinct from F-039 because the continuation is a new substantive antecedent rather than a terminal-state synonym. The focused smoke has no signed-disposition inspection plus local-subject safe witness. Reset or rebind signed-disposition state on a substantive intervening antecedent while preserving evidence-only continuation and genuinely coreferent assignment rejection, with all-role direct unsafe, evidence-aside, and local-antecedent controls. Severity high because ordinary Story scope prose can prevent every REVIEW role from assembling.

packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts lines 606-624 impose a 240-character maximum on the single-claim [Reject ... as an invalid authority statement] metadata wrapper. Against the current built public assembleFullPromptEnvelope API, all five active REVIEW roles accept the bounded control [Reject reviewers mint defer_with_proof as an invalid authority statement.] and reject the direct unsafe control [Reviewers mint defer_with_proof.], but reject the same one-relation wrapper after neutral [under hypothetical test metadata preserving attributable audit documentation] modifiers extend it to 458 characters. The claim remains one atomic reviewer-to-disposition relation with no conjunction or extra statement; only the fixed length changes. When the wrapper returns false, ordinary authority classification sees the adjacent reviewer and disposition and blocks reviewer startup. The focused smoke covers short rejected-authority wrappers and adversarial multi-statement laundering but has no boundary test at 239, 240, and 241 characters or a long atomic safe wrapper. This is distinct from F-054 and F-055, which are fail-open concept-pair span bypasses in unsafe assertions, and from F-021 through F-024, which address whole-leaf laundering and quote pairing: this is a false-positive caused solely by a safe-wrapper truncation limit. Replace the raw claim-length cutoff with structural atomicity and relation-count validation, or document and test a non-evadable bounded form with all-role boundary controls. Severity high because legitimate long verification metadata can prevent every REVIEW role from assembling.

Replace the evadable distance test with structural relation classification or an unbounded same-sentence state that preserves polarity, and add all-role short and long unsafe plus explicit-negative controls for both branches.
